context.root_cause: The FM-3.4 guard's heuristic 'has project: field → requires persistent-task workflow' falsely triggers for project-app planning sessions that use verify-wrap workflow. Planning sessions review/update task trees — they are one-shot reviews, not multi-iteration implementation work requiring persistent-task. The guard had no opt-out mechanism.
context.evidence: 36 out of 42 may-agent workflow runs (85.7%) escalated with 'FM-3.4 Persistent-Task Required'. Only 1 run ever completed successfully. Other project apps (aks-rp-e2e, scout-knowledge-lib) unaffected because they use custom workflows (project-planner, knowledge-planner) rather than verify-wrap.
context.fix_approach: Two-part fix: (1) Add opt-out sentinel check in isPersistentTaskRequired() for 'persistent-task: skip|false|no|off|not-required' in task text. (2) Add 'persistent-task: skip' to may-agent planner task text in app.ts.
